title: Appointments to the East Maui water board
summary: On August 4, 2025, the committee heard from a farmer applying for a council-appointed East Maui board seat; a resolution approving him is to be posted on the August 12 council meeting agenda. In February 2025 the committee voted six to two to recommend the Hawaiian Homes Commission's representative under Resolution 25-50. The council had left that seat blank in June 2023 while awaiting the commission's response.
